entities.summary: Antti Ahlström was a Finnish businessman, who founded Ahlstrom-Munksjö. He was one of Finland's influential and wealthy 19th-century businessman. In addition, Ahlström was an industrialist, ship owner, patron, commercial counselor and legislator.
